thread:
Anya: Quick sync — proposing staged rollout for streaming frame v2 (chunk + meta). Need product/eng/SRE on flags, canary, tenant fallback.

Sam: +1. Top risks? strict client parsers + streaming tail perf.

Anya: Yes. Breakage for parsers that assume shape. Minor perf bump with proxy. Private deployments need runtime toggle.

Lee: Rollout sketch: 0) blue-team 10 hosts; 1) 3 opt-in enterprise tenants; 2) 5% public via X-Stream-Protocol: v2 header; 3) ramp to 100% with auto-cut on thresholds.

Maria: Infra gates: per-tenant circuit-breaker, tenant kill-switch flag, 100% trace sampling for canaries.

Sam: Add server-side session fallback: detect parse error -> rewrite v2->v1 for that session.

Anya: Compat proxy planned behind tenant flag, can rewrite or pass-through.

devops-bot: deploy started: rollout/stream-v2-proxy -> staging.

Sam: Sales/SE - need top-20 customers SDK versions + parser notes by EOD.

sales-eng: On it. CSV by EOD.

Maria: Telemetry gates: parser_exception_rate, streaming_latency_p50/p95, incomplete_stream_count, proxy_fallback_rate. Alert if parser_exception_rate >0.1% for any >1M tokens/day tenant.

Anya: Pre-5% checklist: SDK compatibility doc, 48h canary clear, rollback + tenant-opt-out docs.

Lee: Add Console header to force compat: X-Stream-Compat: v1.

Sam: Proxy adds ~4ms p50 in staging. Maria: acceptable against 30ms p50 SLO?

Maria: +4ms acceptable for opt-in; abort if p95 >100ms.

customer-ops: Private installs need runtime ENV flag in agent 0.9.3.

Anya: Decision items for PL: accept proxy short-term? deprecate v1 in 9 months? which customers need prior notice?

Lee: Vote: proxy OK short-term, deprecate v1 in 9 months, flagged customers opt-in only. +1

Sam: Eng estimate: 2 sprints for proxy hardening + QA/SRE.

Maria: I'll draft runbook fragments and dashboards.

Anya: Action items: Sam — finalize proxy design + perf targets (3d). Maria — dashboards/synthetics (5d). sales-eng — customer list (EOD). Lee — confirm deprecation timeline.

devops-bot: deploy succeeded: rollout/stream-v2-proxy -> staging (build 2026.03.18.07).

Sam: staging log: `frame: {"type":"chunk","data":"...","meta":{"chunk_idx":1,"cursor":"abc123"}} client-parse: OK`.

Maria: staging perf snapshot: p50 +3.8ms, p95 +9.2ms, no parser exceptions in 6h.

Anya: If staging stays green we invite Stage 1 tomorrow morning and post invite list here.
